lessons: Drive's anonymous download links take byte ranges, but after a few dozen requests from one session Drive answers 'Quota exceeded' (a 2040-byte page) for every file, then allows only smaller and smaller ranges. A fresh copy of the file does not help: the limit is on the session, not the file. Pull narrow windows once, through a cache, and never probe repeatedly.
ffmpeg cannot reach Drive through the session proxy; drive_relay.py serves the file on localhost and fetches the pieces with curl.
Once throttled, Drive's anonymous budget is only a handful of requests per few hours, so a 90 MB pull cannot finish in one window. Ask for short exports of the needed timecodes instead.

Composio's GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE (signed in) staged the 311 MB mic WAV in 19 s, but times out (HTTP 504 after 240 s) on the 3.9 GB video; its proxy returns no binary, so signed-in byte ranges are not available that way.
Client rejected generated cutaways in a real founder interview (they read as AI next to real footage). For interview pieces, cover edits with framing changes or real B-roll only.
